subject: urn:ficr:inspection-policy:access-obstruction
object: "Obstruction observed is deficiency; No obstruction observed passes with sufficient support. A missing judgement or inadequate/missing support is unresolved. Missing judgement omits isObscured. The retained door finding is outside equipment totals."^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string>

subject: urn:ficr:inspection-policy:body-condition
object: "Recorded body damage Yes is deficiency; No passes this selected check. A missing observation or insufficient/missing support makes this check unresolved."^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string>

subject: urn:ficr:inspection-policy:functional-test
object: "Recorded test Failed is deficiency; Passed passes this selected check. An unassessed/missing test or insufficient/missing support makes this check unresolved."^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string>

subject: urn:ficr:inspection-policy:service-deadline
object: "Pass iff the recorded service/replacement deadline is on or after assessed date. Earlier is deficiency. A missing date or insufficient/missing support makes this check unresolved."^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string>
